corrected.derivation: Ratio notation: '21/79 oxygen/nitrogen by volume' has no % sign; the parts sum to 100, so O2 = 21/(21+79) = 21 % by volume = 0.21 mole fraction (ideal gas). Nominal chamber-fill composition, not a measured value: the atmosphere is not refreshed between the tests of a day (page 20: 'Midway through a day’s E-FIELD Flames tests, the atmosphere is circulated for 15 minutes through a filter cartridge [...] to capture any soot and adsorb at least a portion of the combustion products'; page 11: flows 'constrained to limit the pressure rise and vitiation of the atmosphere'). Scope: tests shown in Chien et al. 2018 (text reproduced per note on page 19).

verdicts.reason: Ratio notation, nominal environment of four test points.

corrected.derivation: Ratio notation: '21/79 oxygen/nitrogen mixture (by volume)' has no % sign; O2 = 21/(21+79) = 21 % by volume = 0.21 mole fraction (ideal gas). Nominal environment of the four Table 4 test points (second round, gas-jet burner, 100% CH4 at 24 and 19 cm/s), not a measurement: the chamber atmosphere is not refreshed between the tests of a day and is partly filtered of combustion products midway (page 20); flows are limited to restrict vitiation (page 11). The caption does not cover whole test days 18282/18312.
